source: This staff deals damage to every creature in its line of fire; nothing is immune. (If the staff is enchanted, its average damage will increase by %i%%.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会伤害射线上的所有生物，没有生物能免疫。（强化后，平均伤害会提高 %i%%。）

source: This staff deals damage to any creature that it hits, unless the creature is immune to fire. (If the staff is enchanted, its average damage will increase by %i%%.) It also sets creatures and flammable terrain on fire.
zh_CN: 这根法杖会伤害命中的生物，免疫火焰的生物除外。（强化后，平均伤害会提高 %i%%。）它还会点燃生物和可燃地形。

source: The bolt from this staff will poison any creature that it hits for %i turns. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i turns.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖的法术束会使命中的生物中毒 %i 回合。（强化后，会延长至 %i 回合。）

source: The bolt from this staff will dissolve %i layers of obstruction. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i layers.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖的法术束会溶解 %i 层障碍。（强化后，会增至 %i 层。）

source: This staff enables you to teleport up to %i spaces. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i spaces.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖能让你传送最多 %i 格。（强化后，会增至 %i 格。）

source: This staff will compel its target to mirror your movements for %i turns. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i turns.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会迫使目标模仿你的移动，持续 %i 回合。（强化后，会延长至 %i 回合。）

source: This staff will heal its target by %i%% of its maximum health. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i%%.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会为目标恢复其生命上限的 %i%%。（强化后，会增至 %i%%。）

source: This staff will completely heal its target.
zh_CN: 这根法杖会完全恢复目标的生命。

source: This staff will cause its target to move twice as fast for %i turns. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i turns.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会使目标的移动速度翻倍，持续 %i 回合。（强化后，会延长至 %i 回合。）

source: This staff will cause discord for %i turns. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i turns.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会使目标陷入纷争，持续 %i 回合。（强化后，会延长至 %i 回合。）

source: %i phantom blades will be called into service. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i blades.)

source: This staff will shield a creature for up to 20 turns against up to %i damage. (If the staff is enchanted, this will increase to %i damage.)
zh_CN: 这根法杖会为一个生物提供最长 20 回合的护盾，最多抵挡 %i 点伤害。（强化后，会增至 %i 点伤害。）

source: No one knows what this staff does.
